data.content: APPROVED plan review. The plan closes the read-path trust gap without allowing Git configuration or repository bytes to self-attest protection. It binds provider identity, policy revision, trusted writer, ref layout, and exact OIDs; fetches immutable bytes only; rechecks policy/control after fetch; and invokes schema-v22 transactionally for bootstrap and incremental sync. Negative coverage includes pagination omissions, policy rollback, identity substitution, stale/missing OIDs, races, corruption, inbox gaps, offline/provider failure, and unchanged SQLite/object retention. Ownership is separated correctly from write enforcement, signing, integration, and bridge cutover. Implementation must wait for the declared dependencies; no additional operator approval is required.
